propositions: When a bound child's direct parent cannot be represented in Jira (non-epic parent in epic-only project), the outbound differ suppresses the parent field, leaving the child underconstrained with no hint of its context.
The breadcrumb comment must be emitted from the outbound comment differ (_diff_comments), carrying a stable identity tag and RECONCILER_MARKER to enable inbound suppression, avoiding echo loops.
The breadcrumb names the nearest ancestor with a bound Jira key by walking the parent chain upward from the type-collapsed parent, and notes any unrepresented intervening ancestors.

Append-once dedup uses the stable tag <!-- rebar:parent-breadcrumb --> scanned against resolved jira_comments; if present, no new breadcrumb is emitted, preventing duplicates even if the nearest represented ancestor changes.
